mold.C6_verdict: FAIL: equal-magnitude shift on unrelated prompts -> global valence shift

primary_verdict: The pre-registered H1 decision is not supported as a self-report-routing claim. Gold: 71.6% of the v-u gap comes from u being suppressed BELOW the random null, and v_gold is inside the random band (4/20 randoms exceed it; perm p=0.238). Mold: v_mold does exceed randoms (0/20, p=0.048) but control C6 shows an equal-magnitude shift on unrelated factual prompts (+4.54 vs +3.71), so it is a global valence shift, not a self-report channel. C7 monotonicity fails for 3 of 4 directions. Recommended: report as a pre-registered NULL with controls that diagnose why, and move the headline to the lens-reading families.

permutation_p_floor.rule: one-sided exact permutation vs n random directions has min p = 1/(n+1)

J_share_verdict: This is the repo's strongest and cleanest signal (v_mold z=+11.2, v_gold z=+5.1, naive controls at chance z=+0.45/+1.03) and it needs NO new paradigm - only a bigger random cohort. At n=8 the best attainable p is 0.111, so a decisive measurement currently reports as non-significant. n=100/polarity costs ~48 min GPU and yields p=0.0099.
atlas_verdict: Two estimands are in play and neither is pre-specified. (a) The own-pole ratio tabulated in atlas_ratio_instability ranges 0.62x-6.53x and INVERTS (naive > trained) in 3 of 12 cells, including 0.62x for the normalized J-lens readout at the Gold treatment layer. (b) The congruent pole-DIFFERENCE ratio, which is the form the report's quoted 3.9x/9.4x derives from, is even less stable: -9.10x to +47.6x across the same conventions, flipping sign where the naive denominator crosses zero; its closest cell to the quoted pair (J-lens, band L16-31) gives 5.97x gold / 8.16x mold, so neither quoted number is reproduced exactly by any single convention. Only n=6 randoms exist (p floor 0.143). Fix: pre-specify ONE estimand, report the others as robustness, add 100 randoms.

Without a random-jcomp arm in J4, 'affect travels through the speakable component' cannot be separated from a rescaling artifact.

J4_verdict: n=16/cell is ADEQUATE: the observed jcomp-vs-perp gap (1.31-1.50) far exceeds the n=16 detectable difference (0.61). More generations are NOT needed. The gap is a missing control arm, purchasable for ~1.4 min of generation+judge time.
